decisions.statement: Serena remains explicit-only experimental until lifecycle, permission, fallback, ablation and host evidence justify owner-approved promotion.
RTK is shell middleware with per-host enforcement; codex is best-effort until a hard hook exists; reduction is harness-measured.
Routing uses deterministic Task Facts + graph-bound routing; semantic matching is optional discovery only.
External candidate selected set stays empty until hard gates pass.
Capability aliases use additive migration; legacy aliases stay until parity evidence.
No external source is installed or materialized in this phase; recipes are reference only.
decisions.rationale: Supply-chain governance; install authority not granted.
